inputs.text: [excited] Dye… NON… ih… kus. In Greek, "deino" means terrible — [serious] same root as the word "dinosaur"! And "onyx" is claw. [curious] So what does that give us?
[happily] There you go. [proud] It lived in North America, one hundred fifteen million years ago.
[curious] Is this the big scary raptor [gasps] from the movies?
[serious] Yes, actually [gently] it's this one that inspired those images — not the small Velociraptor. But this one had feathers too.
